id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

precomputedFeatures.description: The precomputed features for this entity.

parent.description: The {@link ReliabilityAsset} linked to this alert.

triggeringModel.description: The {@link ReliabilityMlModel} which triggered this alert.

featureContributionMap.description:
Direct mapping of feature name to value based off of the feature contributions associated with the alert.
These feature contributions are normalized and they add up to 1.
They are displayed on the contributions grid on the alert detail page.

primaryModelOutput.description:
A field capturing information about the model output for the {@link timestamp} that the alert is raised.
Supports multiple formats for display in the UI.

allPrimaryModelOutputs.description:
A field capturing information about the model output for the {@link timestamp} that the alert is raised.
Supports multiple formats for display in the UI.

currentState.description: A stored calc field representing the current state - uses a {@link StateMachineHistory} to keep track.

stateHistories.description: A collection of the states this {@link StateMachine} has passed through.

transitions.description: Transitions available from the current state

currentStateHistory.description: Calc field to get the current state history

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

displayMostRecentFeedbackCategory.description: This field is used by the UI to show the translated value of {@link mostRecentFeedbackCategory}.

comments.description: The comments associated with the current Alert

displayedTriggerDate.description: Date displayed in the UI for when the alert was triggered.

relatedCase.description: Case to be used for related cases and alerts.

mostRecentFeedbackCategory.description: {@link ReliabilityAssetAlertFeedback}'s' recent category associated with this alert.

notClosedCaseRelations.description: The {@link ReliabilityAssetAlertToCaseRelation}s with a not `Closed` {@link ReliabilityAssetCase}s in this alert.

notClosedCases.description: The currently `Open` {@link ReliabilityAssetCase}s in this alert.

displayedMlProject.description: Type of the alert. Eg: Reliability Risk.
